items.q: this Indian's sweetheart, she was telling me what makes this girl so unsettled.

ctx.x: again and when I come to Las Vegas to do a show I brought her to Las Vegas. When she arrived I bought a car for her when she arrived, I bought a Chrysler for her when she arrived in America and I called up every day, every day I called Germany, talked to her long distance from The Sands where I had come to work Peter Linda Hays (spelling). I called up every day and found out what was happening, how she was doin'. I had to sell my car before she left over there to come over here. She sold it when she got over here.

The woman that I was telling you about that we met over there and was a friend, this Indian's sweetheart, she was telling me what makes this girl so unsettled. She says you're not married, maybe if you'd marry she'd be more -- she ain't got nothing to depend on. "She can depend on me." "But you're not married to her," that's one point.
